points.quote: `browser/`: core workbench UI, meaning the parts, layout and actions. `common/`: code shared across environments. `electron-browser/`: desktop-only renderer code.
`api/`: the extension host and the implementation of the VS Code API (`vscode`).
`services/`: service implementations. Each is a folder such as `services/foo/{common,browser,electron-browser}`.
`contrib/`: feature contributions. There are about 100 folders, including `chat`, `debug`, `search`, `terminal`, ...

**Services can't import contrib.** `workbench/services/*` may not import `contrib/*`, except in tests ... The same restriction covers `workbench/~` itself. `workbench/api` is allowed to import contrib.
Each contrib has a `*.contribution.ts` file that registers its actions, views, editors, configuration and services.
